narrative: All three coins gained Wednesday — SOL +2.10%, ETH +1.07%, BTC +0.37% — even as a $390 million ETF outflow week and 10% legislative odds for the Clarity Act per CoinDesk kept sentiment cautious; prices and institutional momentum remain out of sync. A hardware security wave hit simultaneously: Coldcard's bug, undetected for years, tallied $100 million in losses per CoinDesk, while Safepal and Bits of Gold reported data breaches affecting nearly 240,000 customers collectively.
